anomalies.observed: C55 pin 1 is listed in both the GND net and the NET0031 net. This ties the FLOAT_HIGH / ESP32 IO1 net to ground while C55 pin 2 is on +3V3.
anomalies.expected: A capacitor pin may belong to only one net. For this float-input path, C55 should not bridge GND to NET0031; the SPICE view shows C55 between NET0031 and +3V3, and the design requires FLOAT_HIGH to remain switchable by the high-level float sensor.
anomalies.impact: The high-level float input is permanently held low, disabling overflow protection and the ATO-valve interlock. If the J4 high-float switch connects its +3V3 side to this net, it would also short +3V3 to GND.

anomalies.observed: The 100 nF capacitors connected to the TMC2209 VCP pins are tied between VCP and +24V: C92 pin 1 is on /NET0039 with U4 pin 6 VCP and pin 2 is on +24V; C25 pin 1 is on /NET0064 with U7 pin 6 VCP and pin 2 is on +24V; C67 pin 1 is on /NET0065 with U11 pin 6 VCP and pin 2 is on +24V.
anomalies.expected: TMC2209 VCP requires its charge-pump capacitor to be connected to GND, not to the motor supply VS/+24V, per the device datasheet and standard practice.
anomalies.impact: The TMC2209 internal charge pump may not develop the required high-side gate-drive voltage, preventing one or more dosing-pump stepper drivers from energizing the coils correctly.
